logger.message: #["CORRELATION ID [" ++ correlationId ++ "] - Started synchronizing sales batch process. Extracting CSV..."]

logger.doc:name: CSV extracted
logger.message: #[output text --- "CORRELATION ID [" ++ correlationId ++ "] - File successfully extracted. Records count: [" ++ sizeOf(payload) ++ "]."]

logger.doc:name: Start processing record
logger.message: #["RECORD ID [" ++ payload.sale_id ++ "] - Starting processing of the record."]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var result = vars.processedRecords map $.payload var dates = result filter !isEmpty($.sale_date) map $.sale_date as Date var euro_amounts = (result filter !isEmpty($.amount_eur)).amount_eur --- { generated_at: now() >> "UTC", period_start: min(dates), period_end: max(dates), total_sales_count: sizeOf(result), total_amount_eur: sum(euro_amounts), by_country: result groupBy $.country_code pluck ((value, key, index) -> { country_code: key, region: value.region[0], country_name: value.country_name[0], sales_count: sizeOf(value), amount_eur: sum( (value.amount_eur filter((item) -> !isEmpty(item))) ), }), by_currency: result groupBy $.currency pluck ((value, key, index) -> { currency: key, sales_count: sizeOf(value), fx_rate: value.fx_rate[0], amount_eur: sum( (value.amount_eur filter((item) -> !isEmpty(item))) ), }), data: result }

logger.doc:name: Data is processed
logger.message: #["CORRELATION ID [" ++ correlationId ++ "] - Data is processed. Sending batch to the treasury destination..."]
#["CORRELATION ID [" ++ correlationId ++ "] - The process is finished."]
#["RECORD ID [" ++ vars.record.sale_id ++ "] - Extracting country data for the record."]
#["RECORD ID [" ++ vars.record.sale_id ++ "] - Country data for the record with country code [" ++ vars.record.country_code ++"] is extracted and processed."]
#["RECORD ID [" ++ vars.record.sale_id ++ "] - Extracting currency data for the record for currency [" ++ vars.record.currency default "" ++ "]."]

logger.doc:name: Record currency is the same
logger.message: #["RECORD ID [" ++ vars.record.sale_id ++ "] - The record\'s currency is identical to the reference currency. Rate and EUR amount are set to default values."]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fx_rate: 1.0, amount_eur: vars.record.amount_local as Number }

logger.doc:name: Record currency is empty
logger.message: #["RECORD ID [" ++ vars.record.sale_id ++ "] - The record\'s currency is empty. Rate and EUR amount are set to null values."]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fx_rate: null, amount_eur: null }

logger.doc:name: Send request to currency service
logger.message: #["RECORD ID [" ++ vars.record.sale_id ++ "] - Sending request to collect currency rate..."]
#["RECORD ID [" ++ vars.record.sale_id ++ "] - Currency data for the record is extracted."]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { method: "POST", path: "/post", body: payload
}
